observations.behavior: Adds a new repository method and its implementation, plus supporting types and a debounce cache, to support re-emitting committed distinct-id mappings.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a read path to fetch the authoritative, committed pairing of a distinct ID to a person and its version, which is required before re-emitting to ClickHouse. This supports recovery and consistency checks.

observations.behavior: Defines the shape of the returned mapping and the repository interface for the new read operation.
observations.code_quote: /** Marks handled mappings so a following no-op does not re-emit them. */
observations.posthog_connection: Implements a cache-backed debounce to avoid repeatedly re-emitting mappings that have already been satisfied, reducing unnecessary ClickHouse writes while still allowing recovery on replay.
